What degraded

  • The deck scored 6.272 on round 5, under the 7.01 floor. It ships on the owner's instruction, recorded verbatim in score.json. All five round 5 hard fails were repaired and re-verified before it shipped.
  • Round 5 was the cap, so the repaired deck was not re-scored by a full panel.

Named here rather than left out. A run that quietly ships less than it planned teaches nobody anything.

Post this

Upload the PDF to LinkedIn as a document, title it Sought by, paste the post copy under it, then paste the first comment within a minute of posting.

carousel.pdf   contact sheet   the site

1. The post copy

ERCOT tracks more than 474 gigawatts in its queue.

The Governor puts data centers at about 90 percent of new requests. Two different denominators.

The Governor said TCEQ will issue no permits sought by data center projects. It waits on two audits. The ERCOT audit covers data centers advancing through the interconnection queue.

A gas compression company says it will supply one data center with 76 megawatts behind the meter from about 40 gas engines. Nothing in the record says whether that project sits in the ERCOT queue, or whether it seeks a TCEQ permit at all.

TCEQ reports on compliance by October 19th. Separately, it canceled the hearing on data center permit O4791 and set no new date. Compliance with which scope?

#TCEQ #ERCOT #DataCenters
